description:
Validate an EU e-invoice XML (UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII, e.g. XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML) against the
official CEN EN 16931 rules and, for XRechnung, the KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 rules. Returns valid, and every error with its rule ID
(e.g. BR-CO-10), a plain-English message, XPath and a fix hint. rules: auto | en16931 | xrechnung. Slovak sellers also get eFaktúra field
checks (FR SR transposition v1.12, warnings with ruleset SK-FS); Norwegian sellers get NO-LAW field checks. Peppol-specific rules are not checked yet.
For PDFs use the REST endpoint POST /einvoice/validate.
name: validate_einvoice
